description: Baseline: 9/12. Fails: escape doesn't close menu (blessed focus), click-text OK partial (API fallback), send-to-terminal timeout after quit (8s not enough), full cycle fails downstream.
9→11: fixed send-to-terminal timeout (sleep 2 before, 10s poll), added overlay render delay before click-text. Still failing: escape doesn't close blessed menu, click-text OK uses API fallback.

12/12 stable (3 consecutive runs). All axes pass: calibrate, ghostty-windows, menu open/close, overlay set-text/confirm, window title+content, quit+restart lifecycle. Benchmark is at ceiling — need new axes to push further.
